headline: Executive order keeps certain existing U.S. restrictions on North Korea and North Korean citizens in place.
what_it_does: This 2008 order by President George W. Bush continues some restrictions the United States already had on North Korea and its citizens, so they do not end. The title alone does not say exactly which restrictions are kept or how they work.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. businesses and individuals dealing with North Korea
who_it_affects.how: They stay bound by the restrictions the order continues, instead of having them lifted.

who_it_affects.group: North Korean citizens and the North Korean government
who_it_affects.how: They remain subject to the U.S. restrictions the order keeps in place.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 26, 2008; the exact effective date is not stated in the title.
